senses.gloss: To have as one's job.
(Christianity) A period of the ecclesiastical year preceding Easter, traditionally involving temporary abstention from certain foods and pleasures.
Lacking stylishness or neatness; shabby.
An overflow of a large amount of water (usually disastrous) from a lake or other body of water due to excessive rainfall or other input of water.
(informal, internet slang, text messaging) Initialism of in my opinion.
Self-assurance.
A en given name.
A tower or other structure exhibiting a light or lights to warn or guide sailors.

A perceived threat or danger.
The act of resigning.
Not showing emotion; calm and in control of oneself.
Peaceful, quiet, especially free from anger and anxiety.
Keeping at rest; inactive; calm; undisturbed.
A person, animal or plant living at a certain location or in a certain area.
Motionless and calm.
One who has possession of any place.
An inhabitant of a borough with full rights; a citizen.
A lack of agitation or disturbance.
The act or process by which something is built; construction.
The process of constructing.
Stubborn; narrow-minded; inflexible.
To a great extent; in essence; essentially.
A name or string of characters used as a person's identification on an individual computer system.
Free from or lacking moisture.
Just, only; no more than, pure and simple, neither more nor better than might be expected. [from 16th c.]
Without water or moisture, said of something that has previously been wet or moist; resulting from the process of drying.
Dry.

A chronic, progressive, fatal central nervous system disease found mainly among the Fore and neighboring peoples of New Guinea, caused by a prion that probably resembles the scrapie agent of sheep, transmissible to nonhuman primates, and believed to be transmitted by ritual cannibalism.
Having had moisture removed; dehydrated, desiccated.
(of a person) Bookish, theoretical and pedantic, as opposed to practical.
A brief summary, as of a book or a presentation.
Any species of game fish belonging to either of the genera Tetrapturus or Makaira, with a crested dorsal fin and a pointed, spear-like projection of the upper jaw.
A large marine fish with a long, pointed bill, Xiphias gladius.
In addition to; as an accessory to.
A bonus or reward, often monetary, to work harder.
To cause to have sorrow or regret.
Any extreme pain, anguish or misery, either physical or mental.

A device consisting of a board on which information about a film being recorded is noted, and a hinged piece which is brought down on the board with a clap at the start and end of each take of the film; it is used to synchronize picture and sound during editing.
The condition of being friends.
The leader of an Arab village, family or small tribe.
The brother or brother-in-law of one’s parent.
A wager, an agreement between two parties that a stake (usually money) will be paid by the loser to the winner (the winner being the one who correctly forecast the outcome of an event).
Of or relating to operations, especially military operations.
The act of placing a bet.
(grammar) Asking or denoting a question.
One who sees or has personal knowledge of something.
A community gathering to celebrate and exhibit local achievements.
An event or series of special events centred on the celebration or promotion of some theme or aspect of the community, often held at regular intervals.
(often, pluralized) A festival or similar celebration.
rigid tube
A continuous series of like events.
A pipe, tube or canal which carries gas or liquid from one place to another
Shaped like a tube.
An enclosed passageway in which to direct a current of air or other gases along.

(nautical) A long, narrow strip, originally of wood but now also of fibreglass, metal, etc., used for various purposes aboard a ship; especially one attached to a mast or spar for protection, one holding down the edge of a tarpaulin covering a hatch to prevent water from entering the hatch, one inserted in a pocket sewn on a sail to keep it flat, or one from which a hammock is suspended.
The pubic bone; the part of the hipbone forming the front arch of the pelvis.
A paddy field, a rice paddy; an irrigated or flooded field where rice is grown.
Family of Indo-Iranian languages of Kurdistan (in the Mesopotamia region, from the Zagros of mid-western Iran to the eastern extension of the chain of the Taurus Mountains).
Solid remains of a fire.
To expose (something) to fumes; specifically, to expose wood, etc., to ammonia in order to produce dark tints.
Like ashes.

(now, chiefly, historical) The substance which remains after a metal or mineral has been thoroughly burnt, once seen as being the essential substance left after the expulsion of phlogiston, but now recognised as being the metallic oxide (or, in some cases, the metal in a state of sublimation).

(geography, now, _, rare) Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
A band worn around the waist to hold clothing to one's body (usually pants), hold weapons (such as a gun or sword), or serve as a decorative piece of clothing.
An architectural element having the shape of an arch
(clothing) A decorative length of cloth worn over the shoulder to the opposite hip, often for ceremonial or other formal occasions.
A belt or sash at the waist, often used to support stockings or hosiery.
A girdle or belt, especially as part of a vestment
An interface for a service, especially for one that is remote, resource-intensive, or otherwise difficult to use directly.
(historical) A member of the Nazi Party (the National Socialist German Workers' Party or NSDAP). [1930]
Having lots of juice.
Wet, soggy or soaked with water.
Consisting mostly of water. Often used in the expression "aqueous solution".
Containing combined water; hydrated.
Someone who visits someone else; someone staying as a guest.
The liquid remaining after milk has been curdled and strained in the process of making cheese.
An establishment that sells goods or services to the public; originally only a physical location, but now a virtual establishment as well.
Needing to drink water or any liquid that can supply water.
From which the water has been removed.
Having little or no water.
Dry, arid, lacking water.
A Jewish scholar or teacher of halacha (Jewish law), capable of making halachic decisions.
The sport of guiding a raft while descending a river, especially through rapids known as white water rafting.
To hold the status of something.
To put aside; to avoid.

To store a file (aggregation of data) on a storage medium such as a disc or another computer.

The brother or brother-in-law of one’s parent.
A macho person; a man who is masculine in an overly assertive or aggressive way.

(automotive, trucking, heavy equipment) A device, usually an assembly of gears (gearbox) plus a clutch or torque converter, through which power is sent from the engine to the driveshaft in an automobile (motor car or motor truck).
That part of a car's transmission containing the train of gears, and to which the gear lever is connected.
(intransitive, medicine, of a disease) To recur; to worsen, be aggravated (after a period of improvement).
A natural substance that is used to make the ground more suitable for growing plants.
Manure; animal excrement.
Animal excrement, especially that of common domestic farm animals and when used as fertilizer. Generally speaking, from cows, horses, sheep, pigs and chickens.
Soft (or slimy) manure.
To conserve.
A city in Williamson County, Texas; named for railroad official Edward Moses Taylor.
A person who fulls cloth.
One who sews.
A person who makes, repairs, or alters clothes professionally, especially suits and men's clothing.
A person who makes or sells cloth or clothing.
A person who sews clothes professionally.
In which the value of a data item (such as time) is represented by a continuous(ly) variable physical quantity that can be measured (such as the shadow of a sundial).
The cardinal number immediately following ninety-five and preceding ninety-seven.
One engaged in politics, especially an elected or appointed government official.
A house, often larger and more expensive than average, in the countryside or on the coast, often used as a retreat.
A non-SI unit of energy, equivalent to 4.184 joules, that can raise the temperature of a gram of water by one degree Celsius. This unit was formerly widely used in chemistry and physics.
Religious discourse; a written or spoken address on a religious or moral matter.
(Christianity) A sermon, especially concerning a practical matter.
A tirade, harsh scolding or rant, whether spoken or written.
(slang) Rather fat; chubby.
(painting, pluralonly) Those fortuitous effects produced by luminous rays falling on certain objects so that some parts stand forth in abnormal brightness and other parts are cast into a deep shadow.
Any adverse event, defeat, or impediment of progress.
An accident, mistake, or problem.
A room, often in a school, where classes take place.
In feudal Japan, a soldier who served a daimyo.
A person engaged in a crusade.
Sharing the same views or opinions, and being in harmony or accord.
A ship or vessel propelled by steam power.
A boat or vessel propelled by steam power.
Not fair.
Not fair, just or right.
(informal) Unpleasantly sticky; yucky; disgusting.

Characterized by iniquity (“deviation from what is right”).

Running or dirtied with mucus.
To mix or confuse.

A type of small open pie, or piece of pastry, now typically containing jelly (US) / jam (UK) or conserve, or sometimes other fillings (chocolate, custard, egg, butter, historically even meat or other savory fillings).
An elongated block of the Earth's crust, bounded by faults, that has dropped relative to the surrounding area.
The hollow or separation between a woman's breasts, especially as revealed by a low neckline.
Approaching death; about to die; moribund.
(transitive) To punish, especially by corporal punishment.
Any great, strong, powerful emotion, especially romantic love or extreme hate.
A feeling of strong desire, especially such a feeling driven by sexual arousal.
To squeeze, compress, or crush (especially something moist).
Inoculation with a vaccine, in order to protect from a particular disease or strain of disease.
(horticulture) The act, art, or process of inserting grafts.

To reflect light.

A sheep-like domesticated animal of the Andes, Vicugna pacos, in the camel family, closely related to the llama, guanaco, and vicuña.

A subatomic particle corresponding to another particle with the same mass, spin and mean lifetime but with charge, parity, strangeness and other quantum numbers flipped in sign; a particle that has a reversed world line to another.
A person who stokes, especially one on a steamship or steam train, who stokes coal in the boilers.
Having an interest in the future, and planning for it.
(informal) streetwise, street-smart.

More than half (50%) of some group.
A person who is skilled at, or practices, endocrinology.

Somewhat depressed; sad.

inside information, the story or truth.

In the International System of Units, the derived unit of energy, work and heat; the work required to exert a force of one newton for a distance of one metre. Equivalent to one watt-second (one watt of power acting for a duration of one second).
one who practices calligraphy

The art of making, and performing with puppets
To give birth to (a foal); to bear offspring.

Clothing of this kind.
Anything used to swaddle with, such as a cloth or band.

A flat sheet of pasta.
A plant belonging to the genus Mimosa usually found in tropical climates, their leaves are usually prickly and sensitive to touch or light, and have small white or pink flowers.
A negative view or hatred of the human race.
A town and ancient city in Messenia prefecture, Greece, formerly named Navarino.
The state of being objective, just, unbiased, and not influenced by irrational emotions or personal prejudices.

Able to read and write; having literacy.
A restaurant that bakes and sells pizzas.

The enjoyment of inflicting pain or humiliation without pity.

A group of Germanic tribes living mostly near Elbe in what is now central Germany around the first century BCE.
Any of the four color-coded tubby human-like characters in the BBC children's television series Teletubbies.
Authorized with a warrant.
The activity of imparting and acquiring skills.
Any activity designed to develop or hone a skill or ability.
One who consistently denies, criticizes, or doubts; a detractor.
An enclosure wherein small animals are displayed, usually with some plants, in a naturalistic setting.
The increase of the rate of a chemical reaction, induced by a catalyst.
The outermost-but-one whorl of a flower, composed of petals, when it is not the same in appearance as the outermost whorl (the calyx); it usually comprises the petal, which may be fused.
A psychiatric diagnosis denoting a persistent, often chronic, mental illness characterised by abnormal perception, thinking, behavior and emotion, often marked by delusions.
(Hinduism) One of the Trimurti (trinity) in Hindu mythology, and the most venerated god in Hinduism.
The fraction of incident light or radiation reflected by a surface or body, commonly expressed as a percentage.
A (commercial) facility where eggs, especially those of fish or poultry, are hatched under artificial conditions.
Making a person seem or become slimmer.
A country in Southern Africa. Official name: Republic of Zimbabwe. Formerly called Southern Rhodesia or Rhodesia.
To flavour food with spices, herbs or salt.
